main_text.l: rum est, quod ais, istos epilogismos se-
esse confectos. Unde hæc tam antiqua
eruere potuit gens Samaritana, ut ad
tanum diserte [?]ראש חדש שביעיinitium mensium anni
septimi. Ipsa dictio [?]צמח eorum dialecto, ut & Chaldaice sonat
tasse hæc noviluniis veris in anno 1584,
aut 1583, in meridiano Sichem, aut Cairi
nec otium mihi nunc, nec si esset, libri
suppetunt: id non tentavit Scaliger; re-
rum istarum pro captu Critici admodum
erat peritus, pro captu vero Astrologi plane ignarus.

page.notes: The Hebrew phrases are only partly legible at this scan size. The first reads roughly "ראש חדש שביעי" (rosh chodesh shevi'i, "beginning of the seventh month") and the second roughly "צמח" (the Samaritan word for "conjunxit"); both are marked [?] and should be checked against the original. The hyphen after "For" in "For-tasse" is faint and may be a printing mark rather than a hyphen. No marginal notes or footnotes are printed on this page.
